Use α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the aluminum film.
Use α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ for the ceramic substrate.
Use ΔT = −180 K for the cooling.
Compute the thermal-mismatch strain in the film as (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
The thermal-mismatch strain is −2.7×10⁻³, which is approximately −0.27%.
The negative sign indicates that the strain is compressive due to cooling.
